Mother’s Name: Berta Hawley Parker

Father’s Name: James Parker, Jr.
Birth Order: Second child of six children

$id

Occupation: Logistics Administrator responsible to the U.S. State Department
for management of U.S. Embassies around the world. I retired from the
U.S. Air Force in November, 1991 after 21 years of service.

Education: Attended N. C. A&T State University in Greensboro, N.C.
Completed several U.S. Military Management and Logistics courses

Family Relationship: Husband of Jacqueline Francis Parker
Son-In-Law of Eddie Rufus Francis, Sr.

Hobbies and Interest: Reading, traveling and working with fatherless boys in my
church and community. I also like to spend time with the elderly to hear

them talk about “The way it was.”
Aspirations: To retire at 55 years of age and work with the youth and elderly.
